protocol.measurement_boundary: Pure simulation cycles from first prompt acceptance to final prompt entry to LOGIT_START or exact terminal edge
protocol.quality_gate: Exact retained signed scores, outputs, stops and every valid KV element at both boundaries
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Pinned model loaded and legacy BOS run before the tested request

quality.evidence: Frozen model and numerical rules unchanged over tested workloads
